title: UFO records 1965 - 311003081
doc_notes: This is a USAF memorandum for the record summarizing several UFO reports from Exeter, New Hampshire, including one close-approach encounter.

encounters.summary: Norman J. Muscarello reported that a silent object with flashing red lights came so close to him while hitchhiking that he had to dodge and fall to the ground to avoid being struck.
encounters.quote: came close enough to him (Muscarello) so as for Muscarello to dodge and fall to the ground
